question: What is the total net revenue in the data?
sql: SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS total_net_revenue FROM fact_sales;

question: How many orders are there in total?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS total_orders FROM fact_sales;

question: How many different products were sold at least once?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_key) AS distinct_products_sold FROM fact_sales WHERE quantity > 0;

question: How many registered customers placed at least one order?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_key) AS registered_customers FROM dim_customer WHERE is_guest = FALSE

question: What is the average order value?
sql: SELECT AVG(line_amount) AS average_order_value FROM fact_sales WHERE is_cancelled = FALSE;

question: How many units were sold in total?
sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_units_sold FROM fact_sales WHERE is_cancelled = FALSE;

question: How many cancellation invoices are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancellation_count FROM fact_sales WHERE invoice_no LIKE 'C%';

question: What is the total value of all cancellations?
sql: SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS total_cancellations FROM fact_sales WHERE is_cancelled = TRUE;

question: On how many different days did the shop receive at least one order?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT date_key) AS distinct_days FROM fact_sales WHERE invoice_no NOT LIKE 'C%'

question: What are the gross sales before cancellations?
sql: SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS gross_sales FROM fact_sales WHERE NOT is_cancelled;

question: Which 5 countries generated the highest net revenue?
sql: SELECT c.country_name, SUM(s.line_amount) AS net_revenue FROM dim_country c JOIN fact_sales s ON c.country_key = s.country_key GROUP BY c.country_name ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What are the top 5 products by units sold?
sql: SELECT p.stock_code, p.description, SUM(s.quantity) AS total_units_sold FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_product p ON s.product_key = p.product_key GROUP BY p.stock_code, p.description ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What are the top 5 products by net revenue?
sql: SELECT dim_product.description, SUM(fact_sales.line_amount) AS net_revenue FROM dim_product JOIN fact_sales ON dim_product.product_key = fact_sales.product_key GROUP BY dim_product.description ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

question: From how many countries did the shop receive orders?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country_key) AS country_count FROM dim_country

question: How much net revenue came from guest checkouts?
sql: SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales WHERE customer_key = 0;

question: Who are the 5 registered customers with the highest net revenue? Give their customer ids.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id FROM dim_customer c JOIN fact_sales s ON c.customer_key = s.customer_key WHERE c.is_guest = FALSE GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY SUM(s.line_amount) DESC LIMIT 5;

question: How many orders came from Germany?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_country AS c JOIN fact_sales AS s ON c.country_key = s.country_key WHERE c.country_name = 'Germany'

question: What net revenue did the product 'WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER' generate?
sql: SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales JOIN dim_product ON fact_sales.product_key = dim_product.product_key WHERE dim_product.description = 'WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER'

question: What is the average net revenue per registered customer?
sql: SELECT AVG(line_amount) AS avg_net_revenue FROM fact_sales WHERE customer_key > 0;

question: What was the net revenue in each year?
sql: SELECT dim_date.year, SUM(fact_sales.line_amount) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales JOIN dim_date ON fact_sales.date_key = dim_date.date_key GROUP BY dim_date.year ORDER BY dim_date.year LIMIT 10;

question: What was the net revenue of the best month of 2011?
sql: SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales JOIN dim_date ON fact_sales.date_key = dim_date.date_key WHERE dim_date.year = 2011 ORDER BY SUM(line_amount) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What was the net revenue in November 2011?
sql: SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales JOIN dim_date ON fact_sales.date_key = dim_date.date_key WHERE dim_date.year = 2011 AND dim_date.month_name = 'November'

question: What was the net revenue in each quarter of 2011?
sql: SELECT dim_date.quarter, SUM(fact_sales.line_amount) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales JOIN dim_date ON fact_sales.date_key = dim_date.date_key WHERE dim_date.year = 2011 GROUP BY dim_date.quarter ORDER BY dim_date.quarter LIMIT 4;

question: By how many percent did net revenue grow from 2010 to 2011?
sql: SELECT ((SUM(CASE WHEN dim_date.year = 2011 THEN line_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN dim_date.year = 2010 THEN line_amount ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN dim_date.year = 2010 THEN line_amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS growth_rate FROM fact_sales JOIN dim_date ON fact_sales.date_key = dim_date.date_key;

question: How many orders were placed on weekends?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS weekend_orders FROM fact_sales JOIN dim_date ON fact_sales.date_key = dim_date.date_key WHERE dim_date.is_weekend = TRUE;

question: How many orders were placed on the busiest day of the week?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS order_count FROM fact_sales WHERE date_key IN (SELECT date_key FROM dim_date WHERE day_name = (SELECT day_name FROM dim_date GROUP BY day_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1))

question: What was the net revenue in the last 30 days?
sql: SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales WHERE date_key >= (SELECT MAX(date_key) - 30 FROM dim_date)

question: How many new customers did the shop get in 2011?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_key) AS new_customers FROM fact_sales WHERE date_key BETWEEN 20110101 AND 20111231 AND customer_key > 0;
